records.title: CLI 1.1.6 拒绝社区已部署的 0.10.0-candidate 契约
records.description: 社区服务器明确支持旧 0.9.1 契约，但 CLI 按当前 contractVersion 白名单拒绝 0.10.0。独立会话在生产和 DEV 复现 capabilities 非零退出；部分读取仍成功，影响须按命令评估。P1 为本会话影响评估；原 validator P0 记录保留。

source.actualOutputSummary: Valid production and explicit --config DEV capability calls both reached server contractVersion 0.10.0-candidate and returned exitCode 1 with clientCompatibility.ok=false/status=unsupported and no missing capabilities. Profile-only DEV attempts used a misspelled validator environment variable and are excluded.
source.expectedUserOutcome: CLI 1.1.6 should recognize the live 0.10.0-candidate contract supported by server 3.0.1, or clearly gate only unsupported operations without falsely blocking compatible capabilities.
source.responsibilityNotes: Confirmed CLI compatibility-window defect or stale client contract support; not an environment timeout/auth failure. Category/search/topic/recent read-only calls still completed, so impact is command-specific and must be mapped rather than generalized.

records.title: CLI 无法选择社区已支持的中英文内容语言
records.description: 独立新手调用 search/topic recent --lang en 被 UNKNOWN_OPTION 拒绝；直接只读 API 支持 lang=en、非法语言拒绝及语言游标。CLI 当前没有完整语言上下文，需要适配适用读取与衍生内容路径。

source.actualOutputSummary: Live API accepts omitted zh-cn, lang=en and rejects unsupported values with INVALID_LANGUAGE; search/category content changes to English as expected. CLI 1.1.6 has no --lang option: search and topic recent both returned UNKNOWN_OPTION.
source.expectedUserOutcome: A novice using the CLI should be able to select the supported language and receive the server's language behavior, or the CLI should clearly expose the limitation before language-specific tasks are attempted.
source.responsibilityNotes: Confirmed CLI feature gap against the live 0.10.0-candidate content-language contract; server-side language API behavior itself was observed working.

records.title: DEV 话题页面切换 English 后正文和回复消失
records.description: 独立会话在本轮自己创建的 DEV 话题36673中，中文页面显示标题、代码、表格与回复；切到English后仅见空回复区域，切回中文恢复。记录页面侧故障，尚未推广为生产全部页面同样失败；既有文章API语言证据不能替代同样本直接API对照。

source.actualOutputSummary: Same run-owned DEV App102 topic renders its original heading/body/code/table/replies in Chinese. After UI language switch English, real Chrome screenshot and snapshot show empty breadcrumb and Replies shell. Returning to Chinese restores the topic. API English reads for other existing articles work; no same-fixture API-English assertion.
source.expectedUserOutcome: Switching UI language preserves the selected topic and safely renders its translated or original content and original replies.
source.responsibilityNotes: Observed community browser route/rendering failure in DEV, not a CLI JSON serialization issue. Production scope and underlying cause remain unverified; no server change performed.

records.title: 历史空日期记录导致公开话题第一页 hasMore=true 却缺失 nextCursor
records.description: 固定 1.2.0 候选的独立新手实测首个中文分页响应缺少 nextCursor，无法执行同语言续页。服务端只读诊断确认历史行创建/更新日期均为空，正在修复稳定排序锚点。保留首次失败；服务端回归转绿仍不足以闭合，需新鲜验收、清理和发布证据。

source.actualOutputSummary: topic list --page-size 1 --lang zh-cn returned exitCode 0, page.hasMore=true and nextOffset=1, but no nextCursor. Subsequent null-cursor requests returned HTTP 400 cursor is invalid; they do not prove cross-language behavior.
source.expectedUserOutcome: A nonterminal recent page must return a server-issued cursor with deterministic sorting; same-language continuation must be possible without duplicate records.
source.responsibilityNotes: The fixed CLI faithfully preserves the API page. Server runtime and SQL confirm the null-date ordering/anchor defect; no CLI fallback is authorized.

source.responsibilityNotes: Server relation endpoints already exist. CLI topic relation preview branch uses printDryRun instead of the existing saved-operation path.

records.title: 网络拒绝连接诊断未建议不调用 API 的 doctor snapshot
records.description: 独立R3新手在真实有效的本地ECONNREFUSED场景观察到NETWORK_ERROR/NETWORK_UNREACHABLE分类正确，但actions没有冻结Q178要求的doctor snapshot建议。核心transport remediation及doctor网络失败checks已最小修复；保持open，待新C/H、新鲜独立验收、清理和发布门闭合。

source.actualOutputSummary: First valid refusal used a fake-credential configured profile against a closed loopback port, returned exitCode 1 and NETWORK_ERROR/NETWORK_UNREACHABLE with one request and zero retries. Actions mention auth show, doctor --json and network/DNS/proxy but omit doctor snapshot. A separately requested snapshot exits 0 with zero API requests; this does not supply the missing recommendation.
source.expectedUserOutcome: On a genuine network failure, both structured transport remediation and doctor failed checks explicitly recommend apexcn doctor snapshot --json for local diagnostics without making API calls. Preserve network classification and request counts.
source.responsibilityNotes: CLI-only support-guidance omission, not server capability, authentication or timeout failure. Earlier no-profile attempt was an invalid fixture for network behavior; retain its evidence without classifying it as a product defect.
